before.program:
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the provided weather data
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
scatter = ax.scatter(df['temp_c'], df['aqi'], c=df['precip_mm'], cmap='viridis')
ax.set_xlabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_ylabel('AQI')
ax.set_title('Temperature vs AQI, colored by precipitation')
colorbar = fig.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax)
colorbar.set_label('Precipitation (mm)')
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
